name: ims.memory-core
description: IMS long-term project memory tools for decisions, issues, and key facts.

tools.name: store_memory
tools.description: Store a long-term memory item for a project via /memories/store.

text.description: Full text/body of the memory (decision, issue, note, fact).

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering and organization.

tools.name: find_memories
tools.description: Search long-term memories for a project via /memories/search.

query.description: Natural language query to search memory text.

kinds.description: Optional list of kinds to filter by (decision/issue/note/fact). Currently advisory only.

tags.description: Optional tags to filter by. Currently advisory only.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10).
